intents.description: Grading scale, SGPA/CGPA calculation, and pass criteria
patterns: What is the grading system in college?
How is CGPA calculated from SGPA?

How is final degree GPA calculated?
intents.response:
Grading System (10-Point Scale):
- O (Outstanding): 90-100% (Grade Point 10)
- A+ (Excellent): 80-89% (Grade Point 9)
- A (Very Good): 70-79% (Grade Point 8)
- B+ (Good): 60-69% (Grade Point 7)
- B (Above Average): 50-59% (Grade Point 6)
- P (Pass): 40-49% (Grade Point 5)
- F (Fail): Below 40% (Grade Point 0)
Passing requirement: Minimum 40% in end-semester theory and 50% aggregate (internal + external). Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) * 10.
